summary: Backend: 19/19 pytest cases PASS covering /dashboard shape, /packages (3 defaults with correct prices), /categories, students CRUD + auto status (on_progress / selesai), transactions CRUD, filter by jenis, bulan_ini filter, soft-delete semantics, and dashboard sisa_kas recomputation after creating transactions. No MongoDB _id leaks observed. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Dashboard, Siswa, and Cashflow screens all load and function correctly end-to-end — Sisa Kas hero card renders 'Rp 1.400.000', all 5 critical dashboard testIDs visible, chart has 7 columns, 'Tambah Siswa' flow creates a new student that appears in the list, Kas Masuk flow saves a transaction (toast 'Kas masuk dicatat' confirmed, totals updated). CRITICAL BUG: Profil tab (testID 'tab-profil') crashes the ErrorBoundary with 'Element type is invalid ... got: undefined. Check the render method of ProfilScreen(./(tabs)/profil.tsx).' — one of the icons imported from lucide-react-native (Instagram, Facebook, MessageCircle, Info, ShieldCheck) is resolving to undefined on web. Tagline 'Terampil Mengemudi, Aman di Jalan.' and handle '@amanahdrive_plg' are NOT visible due to the crash. Also noted non-blocking deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents'.

ui_bugs.issue: Screen crashes with 'Element type is invalid: ... got: undefined' on render. Caught by ErrorBoundary showing 'Something went wrong'. Root cause: one or more icon imports from lucide-react-native at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profil.tsx:14 (Instagram, Facebook, MessageCircle, Info, ShieldCheck) is undefined in the installed lucide-react-native version. Suggested fix: verify each icon name exists in the installed version (e.g., replace MessageCircle with Music2/Music or an inline TikTok icon; verify ShieldCheck/Info are exported). Confirm by temporarily rendering each icon alone, or `console.log({Instagram, Facebook, MessageCircle, Info, ShieldCheck})`.

issues: Tagline 'Terampil Mengemudi, Aman di Jalan.' and @amanahdrive_plg social handles not visible because the screen crashes before rendering.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web; use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx hero style and siswa.tsx fab style.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning on web (likely from an internal RN component). Non-blocking.

rca_of_issue: ProfilScreen crash RCA — the ErrorBoundary message explicitly names ProfilScreen and says 'Element type is invalid ... got: undefined'. Repro: open the app on mobile viewport, navigate to the Profil tab. Trace: profil.tsx imports 5 named icons from lucide-react-native (Instagram, Facebook, MessageCircle, Info, ShieldCheck) and the SOCIALS array stores them as Icon components rendered as <item.Icon color=... size=.../>. If any single named export resolves to undefined in the installed lucide-react-native build, React throws exactly this error. Mitigation: verify each export at runtime (e.g., log them) and swap the undefined one for a defined alternative or an inline SVG.
